question: In August 2021, the third phase of Mission Shakti 3.0 was launched by the Indian state of _________ to empower women and make them self-reliant.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• In August 2021, t**he third phase of Mission Shakti 3.0 **was launched by the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** The main aim of this mission is to **empower women and make them self-reliant.
 
• This initiative focuses on enhancing the safety, dignity, and independence of women through various programs and schemes aimed at improving their socio-economic status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mission Shakti **was launched during the 15th Finance Commission of period of 2021 to 2022 and 2025 to 2026.
 
• The** Government of India** Introduced it under the** Ministry of Women and Child Development.**
 
• Mission Shakti has** two sub-schemes - 'Sambal' and 'Samarthya'**
 
• In the** Sambal subscheme,** which is for the safety and security of women,
 
 
• the existing scheme of One Stop Centre (OSC), Women Helpline (WHL), Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP) have been included with modifications and a new component of Nari Adalat - women collective has been added.
 
 
 
• In the** Samarthya sub-scheme**, which is for the empowerment of women,
 
 
• which includes Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY), Hub For Empowerment of Women, Shakti Sadan, Sakhi Niwas, Palna
